name: Mono-Blue Tempo
notes: 60-card mono-blue tempo inspired by MageZero's Standard-MonoU deck. All-blue counterspell + flash-flier shell — leans hard on holding up mana, which CP7's minimax handles poorly (the value of an uncast counterspell is contextual). Card pool restricted to XMage-evergreen names resolvable via CardRepository — no modal spells, no DFC, no equipment, no planeswalkers.
